adjusted_effect: Pearson correlation between residuals obtained after separately OLS-residualizing rank-transformed S03 and S06 component scores on an intercept and all six rank-transformed cell-state scores.
claim_boundaries: All adjusted variables arise from transcriptomes.
Two wave groups are subsets of one BeatAML study.
Previous raw correlations were already observed.
Residual correlation does not establish causality.
No prognostic or treatment response claim is tested.
multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg over the two wave-level permutation P values

permutation.limitation: Approximate residual-permutation sensitivity test; not exact causal inference.
permutation.method: shuffle one residual vector within wave

result_label: Conditional transcriptomic association; not independent external or orthogonal validation
role: post-hoc fixed sensitivity analysis in previously assessed BeatAML subjects
scientific_question: Does external S03-high vs S06-high opposition remain after adjustment for all six malignant-cell-state scores?
